trigger.rule: I020 remains frozen under its original full-absolute-pass candidate contract. This review is future-only and may not requalify, rerun, repartition, reclassify, or merge I020.

evidence.reviewed_interpretation: The frozen VAD-only I020 patch leaves the failing non-VAD aggregate quality metrics unchanged between baseline and candidate. Requiring overall validation-full PASS therefore couples a VAD source change to pre-existing AEC/BF/public-quality failures outside the candidate's owned impact domain. I020 still fails the VAD absolute min_f1=0.80 gate itself, so impact scoping would not rescue or reclassify it.

reviewed_findings: Baseline evidence validity and candidate quality acceptance are separate concerns; the prior valid-report baseline mode remains correct.
Candidate quality must also distinguish metrics the source patch can own from unrelated aggregate policy metrics.
For a future VAD-state source patch restricted to src/enhance/ap_vad.c, overall validation_result may remain FAIL only because of unchanged non-VAD policy violations.
The future VAD impact scope must still require the validation-full pass-rate and min_vad_f1 policy gates, paired visible/blind VAD regression bounds, and exercised visible candidate behavior.
Every non-VAD summary metric, per-case non-VAD metric, and non-VAD policy violation must remain exactly baseline-equivalent; any drift fails closed.
The existing I020 manifest remains legacy full-absolute-pass and is not eligible for the future-only mode.

candidate_quality_modes.full-absolute-pass: Legacy/default behavior. Candidate visible and blind reports must both have validation_result=PASS.
candidate_quality_modes.vad-impact-scoped-v1: Future-only behavior for one source patch restricted to src/enhance/ap_vad.c. Candidate overall FAIL is allowed only when all non-VAD report behavior and policy violations are baseline-equivalent, while the VAD-impact absolute policy gates and paired VAD bounds pass.

vad_impact_scoped_v1.unaffected_requirement: Non-VAD summary values, non-VAD per-case metrics, and non-VAD violation records must match the baseline report exactly on both visible and blind partitions.

manifest_identity.workflow_and_artifact: Future VAD candidate manifests provide their own non-empty workflow identity, run-bound artifact identity and digest.
manifest_identity.development_seeds: Future manifests provide at least three unique positive fresh development seeds; development evidence must bind exactly to those manifest seeds.
manifest_identity.legacy_i020_values: I020's workflow, artifact and seed values remain frozen in its existing manifest and review rather than hardcoded into the reusable helper.

prohibited: changing validation-full or validation-full-blind thresholds because of I020 values
using impact scope for any patch path outside src/enhance/ap_vad.c
ignoring or suppressing non-VAD validation failures
allowing non-VAD candidate behavior to drift relative to baseline
creating a new I020 blind split
automatic source merge, shipping, HIL, Product Certification, or release
implementation_decision: Extend the existing source-patch blind helper with default-preserving candidate_quality_mode. Missing mode remains full-absolute-pass. Future VAD manifests may explicitly opt into vad-impact-scoped-v1 only with valid-report baseline reference mode and the single canonical VAD source path. Remove I020-only workflow/artifact/seed hardcoding so future manifests are self-describing while legacy I020 remains bound by its own committed manifest and retirement tests.
